newsitem.title: INDIA: India's GAIL sees 96/97 net at 5.67 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India's GAIL sees 96/97 net at 5.67 bln rupees.

text.p: India's state-run Gas Authority of India Ltd (GAIL) is expected to post a net profit of 5.67 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) against 5.15 billion a year ago, its chairman said on Wednesday.
"We expect the 1996/97 profit after tax to be 5.67 billion rupees," GAIL's chairman C.R. Prasad told a news conference in the Indian capital.
Prasad said the profit before tax in 1996/97 was expected to be 7.2 billion rupees compared with 5.39 billion a year ago.
The company expects the sales turnover in the current financial year ending on March 31, to be 47 billion rupees compared with 46 billion in the previous year, Prasad added.
GAIL is India's leading marketer of natural gas, operating a 1,400 km (870 mile) long natural gas pipeline from the western coast to north India, feeding several industries along the way.
